_comment: Tools SlopNet can check for, install and run on your server. 'check' is the command name looked for on the server; 'install' is run on the SERVER, in the console, so you can see exactly what happens; 'run' launches it in the console when it is installed. An empty 'install' means nobody has verified that tool's install command yet — SlopNet says so rather than guessing, because a wrong install command runs as you, on your machine. Every install below downloads in full and checks what it got before anything executes; none of them pipe a download into a shell. Add one and it appears in Settings; no rebuild needed beyond copying this file into the app.

tools.name: Claude Code
tools.source: Z.AI's own Claude Code setup page, 2026-07-29

tools.name: Zellij
tools.install: set -e; mkdir -p ~/.local/bin /tmp/sn-get; curl -fsSL https://github.com/zellij-org/zellij/releases/latest/download/zellij-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz -o /tmp/sn-get/pkg; if ! file /tmp/sn-get/pkg | grep -qi gzip; then echo 'That download is not an archive; nothing was installed.'; exit 1; fi; tar -xzf /tmp/sn-get/pkg -C /tmp/sn-get; found=$(find /tmp/sn-get -type f -name zellij | head -1); if [ -z "$found" ]; then echo 'That archive did not contain zellij; nothing was installed.'; exit 1; fi; install -m 755 "$found" ~/.local/bin/zellij; rm -rf /tmp/sn-get; ~/.local/bin/zellij --version
tools.source: installed and run on a server, 2026-08-01: version 0.44.3, recorded and replayed
